methods.explanation: Tree on ionq.com/roadmap (src 18): S1 = 256-qubit/12-logical system delivered by end-2027, p 0.75 (judgment, post-gate 2026-10-14: system-level testing began by May 2026, src 29; QPUs fabricated and ions trapped in prototypes, but no full-system fidelity published and customer deliveries planned for 2027, src 28, a year after the roadmap's 2026 entry, src 18; IonQ hit its #AQ 35 and #AQ 64 benchmark targets early, src 38, but its 2020 'broad quantum advantage by 2025' became 'commercial advantage for certain applications' in 2025, src 39/38; S1 is a first-of-kind chip-based system, where slips are common: judgment, no base-rate figure). S2 = 10,000-physical/800-logical (roadmap 2027) given S1: by 2029 0.30, 2030-32 0.30, never 0.40 (judgment: a 40x one-year jump; DARPA QBI Stage C entry, src 16, validates the plan, not delivery); no S1 -> no S2. Market outcome given S2 by 2029: leader 0.45 / contender 0.35 / niche 0.20; given late: 0.15 / 0.40 / 0.45; no S2: niche 0.40 / fail 0.60. End states: S2 by 2029 = 0.75 x 0.30 = 0.225, late 0.225, no S2 = 1 - 0.45 = 0.55; leader-early 0.225 x 0.45 = 0.101; leader-late 0.225 x 0.15 = 0.034; contender 0.079 + 0.090 = 0.169; niche 0.045 + 0.101 + 0.55 x 0.40 = 0.366; fail 0.55 x 0.60 = 0.330. 2035 economics: leader 15% x McKinsey mid $57B (src 17) = $8.55B x 25% EBIT (Cisco 24.3%, src 19) x 0.79 x 18x NOPAT (IBM 17.8x-HON 22.0x NTM P/E, src 21) = $30.4B / 1.15^8.2 = $9,662M at the horizon (late: 10.2 years, $7,306M); contender 6% x $57B x 18% x 0.79 x 18 / 1.15^8.2 = $2,783M; niche 1.5% x $43B x 10% x 0.79 x 15 / 1.15^8.2 = $240M; fail 0. Less post-horizon development spend incl. SBC (PV, judgment from Q2-26 adj. EBITDA -$120.3M/qtr, src 8, plus SBC, F46): leader $2,800M (late $3,200M), contender $2,500M, niche $1,000M, fail $1,000M wind-down. Equity per state = $3,256M + $2,100M + net computing - warrant claim (BS, vol 60% judgment, r 4.5%; A 4.74y, B 5.0y, C 6.0y, src 27/1), / 536.4M: $21.05 / $16.52 / $10.08 / $8.28 / $7.86; weighted 0.101 x 21.05 + 0.034 x 16.52 + 0.169 x 10.08 + 0.366 x 8.28 + 0.330 x 7.86 = $10.02 (was $10.15 at p(S1) 0.80). Discount 15%: failure sits in the tree; the rate covers financing and execution risk (judgment). Cross-check: Kalshi 'useful QC' before 2035 48% (src 31, thin market).

McKinsey Quantum Technology Monitor 2026 (April 2026, via PostQuantum, src 17): quantum computing $43-71B by 2035. States (judgment): leader p 0.12 = 15% of $71B = $10.65B x 25% EBIT x 0.79 x 18x / 1.15^8.2 = $12,040M less $2,800M spend; major p 0.22 = 6% of $57B at 18% -> $2,780M less $2,500M; niche p 0.30 = 2% of $43B at 10%, 15x -> $320M less $1,000M; obsolete (another modality wins: DARPA QBI Stage C holds neutral-atom, silicon-spin, superconducting and trapped-ion teams plus Microsoft and PsiQuantum, whose approaches the page does not state, src 16) p 0.36 -> 0 less $1,000M. Same bridge, warrants per state: $24.89 / $10.08 / $8.42 / $7.86 -> 0.12 x 24.89 + 0.22 x 10.08 + 0.30 x 8.42 + 0.36 x 7.86 = $10.56. Anchor: IonQ FY2025 revenue $130.0M (F3) vs >$1B 2025 sector revenue (src 17), ~13%, an upper bound for its computing share.

Floor = net cash at horizon $3,256M + operating units $2,100M = $5,356M = $9.99/share before warrants, $9.59 after the warrant claim at the floor (net cash alone $6.07). Option: S = probability-weighted PV of success-state gross values from (a) = 0.10125 x 9,662 + 0.03375 x 7,306 + 0.16875 x 2,783 = $1,694M (was $1,807M at p(S1) 0.80); K = $2,000M development spend to fault tolerance, stated as the undiscounted amount payable over the option's life (judgment: ~4 years x ~$480M/yr adj. EBITDA loss, Q2-26 -$120.3M/qtr, src 8 = $1,920M, rounded up). K is deliberately not a PV: Black-Scholes discounts the strike itself (K x e^-rT = 2,000 x e^-0.18 = $1,671M), close to the PV at 4.5% of $480M a year over years 1-4 ($1,722M; the matching at-expiry strike is 1,722 x e^0.18 = $2,062M); entering a PV as K would discount twice; T = 4 years (IonQ 2029-30 fault-tolerance targets, src 18; DARPA utility-scale test by 2033, src 16); sigma 90% (one-year realized equity vol 92% per the run brief, src 34, a run market statistic rather than a published page; the computing option is the most volatile asset; judgment); r 4.5% -> Black-Scholes $1,075M. ($5,356M + $1,075M - warrants $297M) / 536.4M = $11.43 (was $11.59). Captures abandonment flexibility the rNPV ignores.

Unit: EV per trapped-ion computing platform. Quantinuum: 263.31M shares (36.89M A + 226.41M B, src 14) x $33.51 (src 30) = $8,824M, less cash $2,106.7M at 6/30 net of ~$75M Q3 burn = EV $6,792M. methods_summary.measures: Treats IonQ's published roadmap like a drug pipeline: the odds of each technical step arriving on time, late or never, and what the business is worth in each outcome, net of the money it must still spend.
methods_summary.why_weight: Largest weight: it values the thing that actually drives IonQ (the roadmap) with explicit, checkable probabilities and costs, but those probabilities are judgment.

methods_summary.measures: What IonQ is worth if it wins 15%, 6%, 2% or 0% of a $43-71B 2035 quantum computing market (McKinsey 2026), at mature-hardware margins, discounted back.
methods_summary.why_weight: An independent, top-down view of the same question as (a); it rests on a single published market forecast, so it gets less weight than the roadmap tree.

methods_summary.measures: Net cash plus the operating businesses as a floor ($9.6/share after warrants), plus the computing programme valued as a call option that IonQ can abandon if it fails.
methods_summary.why_weight: Captures the asymmetric payoff and the abandonment value the tree ignores; the option inputs (volatility 90%, $2.0B strike, the undiscounted ~4-year spend that the option model itself discounts) are judgment, so it is not weighted above (a).

methods_summary.measures: Prices IonQ's computing at 0.9x the enterprise value the stock market puts on Quantinuum, the listed trapped-ion rival (~$6.8B).
methods_summary.why_weight: The only market-based mark for a comparable platform, but it imports the same sector sentiment we are trying to judge, so its weight is capped at 0.15.

methods_summary.measures: Values each acquired business against its own non-quantum peers (SkyWater against foundries, the rest against security and space peers) and the computing technology at what IonQ paid for Oxford Ionics and Lightsynq.
methods_summary.why_weight: Grounded in filed deal prices and peer multiples, but the cost of a technology bought with richly priced stock is a generous, not a fair, value.

methods_summary.measures: What today's price requires: ~$12.5B for computing, i.e. ~26% of the 2035 quantum computing market with certainty.
methods_summary.why_weight: It restates the market price rather than valuing the company; it shows how demanding $31.5 is and is used to judge the other methods.

S2 = 10,000-physical/800-logical (roadmap 2027) given S1: by 2029 0.30, 2030-32 0.30, never 0.40 (judgment: a 40x one-year jump; DARPA QBI Stage C entry, src 16, validates the plan, not delivery); no S1 -> no S2. Market outcome given S2 by 2029: leader 0.45 / contender 0.35 / niche 0.20; given late: 0.15 / 0.40 / 0.45; no S2: niche 0.40 / fail 0.60. End states: S2 by 2029 = 0.75 x 0.30 = 0.225, late 0.225, no S2 = 1 - 0.45 = 0.55; leader-early 0.225 x 0.45 = 0.101; leader-late 0.225 x 0.15 = 0.034; contender 0.079 + 0.090 = 0.169; niche 0.045 + 0.101 + 0.55 x 0.40 = 0.366; fail 0.55 x 0.60 = 0.330. 2035 economics: leader 15% x McKinsey mid $57B (src 17) = $8.55B x 25% EBIT (Cisco 24.3%, src 19) x 0.79 x 18x NOPAT (IBM 17.8x-HON 22.0x NTM P/E, src 21) = $30.4B / 1.15^8.2 = $9,662M at the horizon (late: 10.2 years, $7,306M); contender 6% x $57B x 18% x 0.79 x 18 / 1.15^8.2 = $2,783M; niche 1.5% x $43B x 10% x 0.79 x 15 / 1.15^8.2 = $240M; fail 0. Less post-horizon development spend incl. SBC (PV, judgment from Q2-26 adj. EBITDA -$120.3M/qtr, src 8, plus SBC, F46): leader $2,800M (late $3,200M), contender $2,500M, niche $1,000M, fail $1,000M wind-down. Equity per state = $3,256M + $2,100M + net computing - warrant claim (BS, vol 60% judgment, r 4.5%; A 4.74y, B 5.0y, C 6.0y, src 27/1), / 536.4M: $21.05 / $16.52 / $10.08 / $8.28 / $7.86; weighted 0.101 x 21.05 + 0.034 x 16.52 + 0.169 x 10.08 + 0.366 x 8.28 + 0.330 x 7.86 = $10.02 (was $10.15 at p(S1) 0.80). custom.name: (e) Cash floor plus computing option
custom.explanation: Floor = net cash at horizon $3,256M + operating units $2,100M = $5,356M = $9.99/share before warrants, $9.59 after the warrant claim at the floor (net cash alone $6.07).
